title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - DataUsageAgreement
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/DataUsageAgreement. A formal agreement between a Data Right Holder and a Data Consumer.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'DataUsageAgreement'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

dataRightsHolder.description: Relationship. The person holding legal rights on the data contained in the Data Product and signing the Data Usage Agreement. Links to a LegalPerson entity.

dataConsumer.description: Relationship. A resolvable link to the Gaia-X Credential of the participant using the Data Product. Links to a Participant entity.

gxDataProvider.description: Relationship. A resolvable link to the Gaia-X Credential of the participant providing the Data Product. Links to a LegalPerson entity. Named 'gxDataProvider' here (instead of the source ontology's own 'dataProvider') to avoid colliding with this schema's boilerplate 'dataProvider' metadata property (harmonised-data-entity provider), which is a distinct concept.

dataInstance.description: Property. A text that is understandable by the Data Rights Holder and that the Data Provider can map to a specific instance of a data set.

odrlProfile.description: Property. The identifier(s) of an ODRL Profile that the Policy conforms to.

dataAccessPrerequisites.description: Relationship. The conditions that the Data Consumer must fulfill to be given access to the data sets. Links to one or more DataAccessPrerequisite entities.

dataUsageConstraints.description: Relationship. The constraints that the Data Consumer contractually commits to respect when using the data sets. Links to one or more DataUsageConstraint entities.

dataUsagePurpose.description: Property. The purpose accepted for usage of the data set.

dataUsageLegalContext.description: Property. Textual version of the Data Usage Agreement.
